items: A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,

The door of the battery room must be provided 
 with NO Smoking signs.

The battery instructions must be displayed 
 visibly on the wall..

Water source must be available in the battery 
 room.

When working in the battery room be aware of 
 parts under voltage.

The battery set is 
 out of service if necessary.
Make sure that the cells are clean and dry, externally clean the caps.
Check the connections are properly tightened lubricate and fully screw them.
Check and read the voltage of each cell.

Make partial discharge with nominal power during a time equal to the half of 
 the battery autonomy.

For that stop the floating charge ( rectifiers ) and note regular times equal 
 to 1/10 of the autonomy the total voltage and the using current.

Before stopping the discharge, note the voltage of each cell. it will show if 
 the autonomy is still good and if any cell is not working bad.

Measure the battery internal resistance of the battery ref. to MPIS doc no. 
 B-021-r0
Place the battery set back into normal operating condition

Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be 
performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block
Type: Lead Acid Battery 
Maintenance Free
No. of Cells: 24
Cell Voltage: 2v
Capacity: 300 Ah
The first draft initiated 
by eng. Abdallah Elsayed M, revised by quality control eng. Adel Abd EL kader 
El nagar at EDEP Co., Accepted by eng El Sayed Attiah, and approved by eng. Awad 
Soliman Head Sector of Talkha PS.
Safety
Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
The door of the battery room must be provided 
 with NO Smoking signs.
The battery instructions must be displayed 
 visibly on the wall..
Water source must be available in the battery 
 room.
When working in the battery room be aware of 
 parts under voltage.
The battery set is 
 out of service if necessary.
Tools and Equipment
Digital multimeter ( AVO METER )
Work to be Carried Out
Make sure that the cells are clean and dry, externally clean the caps.
Check the connections are properly tightened lubricate and fully screw them.
Check and read the voltage of each cell.
Voltage must be homogeneous within 
 0.02v.
Make partial discharge with nominal power during a time equal to the half of 
 the battery autonomy.
For that stop the floating charge ( rectifiers ) and note regular times equal 
 to 1/10 of the autonomy the total voltage and the using current.
Before stopping the discharge, note the voltage of each cell. it will show if 
 the autonomy is still good and if any cell is not working bad.
Measure the battery internal resistance of the battery ref. to MPIS doc no. 
 B-021-r0
Place the battery set back into normal operating condition
